# R3.2 — Durable-execution residual producers (DF-S2.3-1 / BL-44)

**PR:** https://github.com/SteveVitali/HarnessHarness/pull/138

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/138_R3.2__durable-execution-residual.md`
(seq 2 of 11, Round 3, manifest row 138). **Requirement ids:**
`DF-S2.3-1`, `BL-44`; `R-2.2.3`, `R-2.4.3`, `R-2.5.5`, `R-2.6.3`,
`R-2.8.7`, `R-2.12.6`; ADR-0265 (re-checked, dated). **Base:**
`svitali/harnessharness-r3.1` — the stacked R3.1 tip (operator merges;
mergePolicy: OPERATOR). **Layer:** fixture-verified — offline/hermetic
only; no staging/live claims, no credentials, no production mutations.

## What

Discharges **DF-S2.3-1**'s five residual producer legs — every
wakeup/lease producer now mints its durable row from a real path under
the run's single fenced writer — and closes **BL-44**:

**1. `resume_set` producer (R-2.4.3).** `ViewKind::ResumeSet` — the
§5c.3 materialized view as a pure fold over durable
`context.memory.written`/`invalidated` (session-scope heads by name,
canonical order, latest-invalidated dropped; `deriver = kernel`,
restart-rebuildable). `Store::resume_set_heads` feeds `continue_goal`'s
`carried.resume_set_heads` when the caller omits it — an explicit `[]`
is honoured as an empty set — and the `checkpoint` payload carries the
derived member. One fold, three readers (CC1).

**2. `defer` producer (R-2.8.7) — verified landed.** The dispatch ask
path has minted `wakeup_subscribe(PermissionDecided)` bound to the
durable `pending` row since S2.6 (`hh-env/src/dispatch.rs`;
`ac_r_2_8_7_*` batteries green).

**3. Child-lease producers (R-2.6.3) — verified landed.** Spawn mints
`child_terminal` subscriptions under the parent lease; child
termination releases `resource:*` locks (`hh-subagent`; s4_6/s4_8/
s4_16b green). The substrate R3.3 consumes.

**4. Non-fleet ingress-adapter producers (R-2.12.6).**
`connection_info.ingress_adapters[]` validates at `open_session`
(malformed ⇒ `SchemaViolation`) and stamps
`manifest.extra.ingress_adapters`; `wakeup_subscribe` admits non-fleet
`external`/`manual` only under a declared entry — undeclared ⇒ typed
`TriggerUnsupported` stage-4, fleet behaviour unchanged.
`hh_fleet::observe_run` is the non-fleet producer:
`context.observation.recorded` + `control.wakeup.occurred` durable
before `deliver_wakeup` fires (CC3); replay dedup audited; uncovered
occurrences never fire.

**5. `heal(env_handle)` surface (R-2.5.5).** `EnvDriver::heal_handle`
— suspended → resume; unreachable + live session → reattach; dead
channel + recorded session → `resume_helper` first; otherwise replace
per `on_loss` (`Replaced{successor_env_handle_id}`) or `fail_run` ⇒
durable `action.environment.failed` + `Failed`. The §5a.3 policy-level
heal composes over it; the lost-local-host-workspace replacement
invariant is preserved.

**6. ADR-0265 re-check dated 2026-10-14.** The second revisit arm
fired — **D4 stands**: the woken dedup set needs no durable home (all
producers mint the same `control.wakeup.*` rows through
`deliver_wakeup`; at-least-once re-delivery of a crash-surviving
`fired` row is the AC-7 semantics). D2/D7 quiet.

Regression updates: the three pre-existing external-subscription
fixtures (`hh-ledger s4_13`, `hh-embed conformance`, `hh-embed r2_3`)
declare their ingress adapter for the new gate.
